LanguageData.TMM_MinutemenHuntersFaction.label: minutemen and hunters
LanguageData.TMM_MinutemenHuntersFaction.description: An alliance of frontier civil minutemen and wandering monster hunters. Organized around mutual community aid ("ready in a minute") and equipped to protect distant outposts from wild beasts and supernatural threats. They maintain archives of protective wards and stand ready to answer distress signals.
